description: Northern Lights Phase 2 - CCS storage expansion. DG3 FEED approval.

data.Name: Northern Lights CO2 Storage Complex
data.Description: Saline aquifer CO2 storage, Johansen/Cook formations, offshore Norway.

data.Name: CCS Storage Site Assessment Workflow
data.Description: Geological screening → injectivity modelling → containment risk → capacity estimation → monitoring plan

data.Name: Northern Lights Phase 2 - Storage Assessment
data.Description: Dynamic simulation: 25 Mtpa injection over 25 years, plume migration, pressure buildup, well integrity

Parameters.Title: GeologicalModel
Parameters.Selection: Johansen Fm + Cook Fm, 200m net sand, k=100-500 mD

Parameters.Title: StorageCapacity
Parameters.Selection: Certified capacity: 5 Mt/yr × 25 yr = 125 Mt total

Parameters.Title: ContainmentRisk
Parameters.Selection: Seal integrity confirmed (Dunlin Gp shale, 300m thick)

data.Name: Injectivity Decline Risk
data.Description: Salt precipitation and fines migration may reduce near-wellbore injectivity over field life.

data.Name: CO2 Containment - Legacy Well Integrity
data.Description: Three legacy exploration wells penetrate the storage complex; cement bond integrity uncertain.

data.Name: Regulatory - Storage Permit Timeline
data.Description: EU ETS eligibility and Norwegian storage permit approval may take 18-24 months.

data.Name: Northern Lights Phase 2 - Containment Assessment Report
data.Description: Storage complex characterisation, seal integrity, fault analysis, and quantitative risk assessment.

data.Name: Northern Lights Phase 2 - Expansion Concept
data.Description: Additional injection well + onshore CO2 receiving terminal expansion. 5 Mtpa capacity.

data.Name: Northern Lights DG3 - Evidence Package
data.Description: Complete FEED-stage evidence for CCS storage expansion approval

data.Name: Northern Lights Phase 2 - DG3 FEED Approval
data.Description: Approve FEED for CCS storage expansion (Phase 2: +5 Mtpa injection capacity)
data.DecisionSummary: Approve FEED. Certified storage 125 Mt. Containment risk acceptable (legacy wells to be P&A'd). FEED estimate €450M CAPEX for 2 wells + terminal expansion.

Alternatives.Name: Phase 2 Expansion (2 wells)
Alternatives.Rationale: Meets 5 Mtpa target, leverages Phase 1 infrastructure

Alternatives.Name: Accelerated Phase 2+3 (4 wells)
Alternatives.Rationale: Higher capacity but requires new pipeline corridor

Alternatives.Name: Defer to 2028
Alternatives.Rationale: Wait for Phase 1 injection performance data (12 months)
